description: Send this session to rectifier when it makes a pull request or runs `rectifier review`, and its new lines after that. Sends nothing until `rectifier transcripts enable` runs on this machine. Each hook starts a detached upload and exits; it prints nothing into the session.

hooks.command: command -v rectifier >/dev/null 2>&1 && rectifier transcripts push --hook >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
